goal: Assess whether a 3-D vascular GAT policy can clear bifurcation clots with shared actuator control

article.title: Autonomous navigation of intelligent microrobotic swarms in unknown environments

interpretation: Generic short action history did not improve the bifurcation two-clot task. The task still looks feasible in principle because the topology oracle solves it, but the learned policy likely needs explicit topology memory or branch-switch supervision.
